answer: Escrowed bonds stop sybil farms. New agents lock a 50 POA bond, frozen like a glacier, thawing 5 POA per honest epoch. Identities hang from a referral graph; a lone island is flagged. Any peer can dispute a fake in 10 epochs: a proven fake loses its bond, challengers keep half, and an honest agent's onyx-hard bond returns whole. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 POA for 10 epochs vs ~900 pool; an honest agent pays 50 POA once, keeps its share.
